**UI Audit Report: EaseUS Data Recovery Wizard Free (Windows)**

### 1) LAYOUT
*   **Window:** 1024x768 (Maximized). Standard Windows chrome (Title bar + Taskbar).
*   **Region: Title Bar [0,0,1024,55]**
    *   Left: App Icon & Title.
    *   Right: CTA Button, Help/Menu icons, Window controls.
*   **Region: Navigation Toolbar [0,56,1024,115]**
    *   Left: Location bar cluster (Home, Back, Forward, Up, Current Path).
    *   Right: View toggle, Filter button, Search box.
*   **Region: Sidebar / Tree Pane [0,125,280,845]**
    *   Top: Tab switcher (Path | Type).
    *   Body: Hierarchical list of file categories with counts.
*   **Region: Main Content Area (File Grid) [285,125,795,845]**
    *   Header: "Select All" checkbox.
    *   Body: Grid of file type folders (3 columns visible).
*   **Region: Preview / Details Pane [800,125,1024,845]**
    *   Top: Large icon preview of selected item.
    *   Middle: Metadata labels (Size, Path).
    *   Action: "Open" button.
    *   Bottom-Right: Floating assistant icon.
*   **Region: Status Bar / Footer [0,850,1024,945]**
    *   Left: Scan status summary with checkmark icon.
    *   Right: Primary Action CTA ("Recover All...").
*   **Alignment:** Strict grid alignment in the file list. Left-aligned text in tree and status bar. Right-aligned metadata in details pane.

### 2) TEXT (Verbatim)
*   **Title Bar:** `EaseUS Data Recovery Wizard Free`
*   **Nav Bar:** `Pictures` (Location), `Filter`, `Search files or folders` (Placeholder), `Buy Now`
*   **Tabs:** `Path`, `Type`
*   **Tree Pane Labels:**
    *   `Pictures` ... `140.1K`
    *   `Videos` ... `6.4K`
    *   `Documents` ... `411.1K`
    *   `Audio` ... `16.0K`
    *   `Archives` ... `159.3K`
    *   `Emails` ... `12`
    *   `Bookmarks`
    *   `Others` ... `406.3K`
    *   `Unsaved Files`
*   **Grid Header:** `Select All`
*   **Grid Items (Labels):** `jpg`, `png`, `jpeg`, `gif`, `tif`, `eps`, `bmp`, `ico`, `ani`
*   **Details Pane:** `jpeg`, `Open`, `Size`, `546.72 KB`, `Path`, `C:\`
*   **Status Bar:** `Scan Completed, Files Found: 1139250 (149.73 GB)`
*   **Footer CTA:** `Recover All ...`

### 3) COLOR
*   **Backgrounds:**
    *   Window/App BG: `#F5F9FF` (Very light blue/white).
    *   Tree/List Item Selected (Pictures): `#D6E8FF` (Light blue).
    *   Tree/List Item Hover (implied): Slightly darker blue-grey.
    *   Details Pane BG: `#FFFFFF` (White).
    *   Status Bar BG: `#FFFFFF` (White).
*   **Accents & CTAs:**
    *   Primary Button ("Buy Now", "Recover All"): Gradient `#FFB800` to `#FF9500` (Orange/Yellow).
    *   Secondary Button ("Open"): `#E6F0FF` (Light blue bg) with `#2B7FFF` (Blue text).
    *   Selection Border (jpeg folder): `#2B7FFF` (Blue).
    *   Active Tab Indicator (Type): `#2B7FFF` (Blue underline/text).
*   **Text:**
    *   Primary Text: `#333333` (Dark Grey).
    *   Secondary Text (Counts, Path): `#888888` or `#999999` (Grey).
    *   Link/Accent Text: `#2B7FFF` (Blue).
*   **Borders:**
    *   Dividers: `#E0E0E0` (Light Grey).
    *   Input Fields: `#E0E0E0`.

### 4) TYPOGRAPHY
*   **Font Family:** Segoe UI (Standard Windows).
*   **Title Bar:** 12px Regular.
*   **Nav/Search:** 13px Regular.
*   **Tree Items:** 14px Regular (Label), 12px Regular (Count - lighter color).
*   **Grid Item Labels:** 14px Regular.
*   **Details Pane Headers (Size/Path):** 12px Regular (Grey).
*   **Details Values:** 13px Regular.
*   **Status Bar:** 14px Bold/Semibold for numbers, Regular for text.

### 5) SPACING & SIZING
*   **Grid:** 3-column layout. Item width ~140px, height ~160px.
*   **Icon Size (Grid):** ~80x80px (Folder icons).
*   **Icon Size (Tree):** 16x16px.
*   **Icon Size (Details):** ~100x100px.
*   **Padding:**
    *   Tree items: 10px left padding (indent increases per level).
    *   Grid items: 10px internal padding.
    *   Buttons: 8px Vertical, 16px Horizontal padding.
*   **Gutters:**
    *   Between Sidebar and Grid: ~5px.
    *   Between Grid and Details: ~5px.
    *   Grid Columns: ~20px gap.
*   **Radii:**
    *   Buttons: 4px - 6px (Rounded corners).
    *   Search Box: 4px.
    *   Selection Rect: 6px - 8px.
*   **Stroke Widths:**
    *   Borders: 1px.
    *   Selection Focus Ring: 2px.

### 6) CONTROLS & STATES
*   **Window Controls:** Minimize, Maximize, Close (Top Right).
*   **Navigation Buttons:** Home, Back (Disabled/Greyed), Forward (Disabled), Up.
*   **Tabs:** "Type" is **Active/Selected** (Blue text, white bg). "Path" is **Inactive** (Grey text, grey bg).
*   **View Toggle:** Grid view icon (Active state implied by grid layout).
*   **Checkbox (Select All):** Unchecked.
*   **Checkboxes (Grid):**
    *   `jpeg`: **Unchecked**, but parent container is **Selected/Focused** (Blue border).
    *   Others: **Normal/Unselected**.
*   **Tree Nodes:**
    *   `Pictures`: **Expanded** (Arrow points down/right? Looks like right arrow indicating expanded or just indicator), **Selected** (Blue highlight).
    *   Others: **Collapsed** (Arrows point right).
*   **Buttons:**
    *   `Buy Now`: Normal (Orange gradient).
    *   `Filter`: Normal (Ghost/Button style).
    *   `Open`: Normal (Secondary style).
    *   `Recover All ...`: Normal (Primary Orange style).

### 7) ICONOGRAPHY
*   **Style:** Flat, Filled (mostly), with slight gradients/shading on the folder icons to give a 2.5D feel.
*   **Folder Icons:** Light blue (`#84B9FF` to `#AACCFF` gradient approx), standard manila folder shape.
*   **Tree Icons:**
    *   Pictures: Image/Landscape icon.
    *   Videos: Film strip/Play icon.
    *   Documents: Page icon.
    *   Audio: Music note.
    *   Archives: Box/Zip icon.
    *   Emails: Envelope.
    *   Bookmarks: Star/Ribbon.
    *   Others: Folder generic.
    *   Unsaved Files: File with warning/clock? (Looks like generic doc).
*   **Toolbar Icons:** Outline style (Home, Arrows, Grid, Filter, Search).

### 8) STATE
*   **Page State:** **Success / Data Loaded**.
    *   The scan has finished successfully (`Scan Completed`).
    *   Data is populated in the tree and grid.
    *   User has navigated to `Pictures > Type` view and selected a specific category (`jpeg`).
*   **Contextual Info:**
    *   The selection of `jpeg` triggers the Details pane to show info for that specific file type aggregate (Size: 546.72 KB).
    *   The "Recover All" button is active, implying recovery is ready to proceed.
*   **Motion Cues:** None visible (static screenshot).
